value.rationale: Four binary pixels have sixteen possible readings and 2-by-8 is a minimum-site two-row torus for such location tags. The exact common 64-array solution set for twelve masks, including four disconnected cell shapes, is a natural complete design-space classification; the sharp three-mask obstruction and two inequivalent orbits distinguish robust designs rather than a routine single-example computation.
